iteration_disclosure: This design follows inspection of earlier 2017-2023 grids. Discovery is therefore iterative and not independent evidence; only the declared post-2023 stages can test the frozen selection rule.
hypothesis: A simple initial stop, exit, and exposure combination can retain positive expectancy while holding daily mark-to-market drawdown at or below 10%, and a rule selected without future performance can persist on post-2023 data.
signal: MODEL_0 false-to-true Stage 2 eligibility transition after the close
entry: next available session open plus 5 bps adverse slippage

execution.cash_and_notional_model: Normalized R; no cash or maximum-notional constraint

neighbor_support: A supported cell has an adjacent exit in the same family, stop, and exposure with positive expectancy, profit factor at least 1.10, maximum drawdown at most 12%, at least 75 trades, and non-negative early and late discovery returns.
discovery_selection: Select at most three gate passes. Supported cells rank before unsupported cells, then descending CAGR-to-drawdown, descending expectancy per allocated R, ascending combined complexity, and stable cell id.
holdout_rule: Evaluate 2025 exactly once only for candidates passing the validation gate. Report every evaluated result without changing the frozen candidate.
decision_rule: Even a holdout pass remains HOLD because the archive is survivorship-biased. Forward-test or production promotion requires a separate review and authorization.
constraints: Freeze selected candidates before calculating validation outcomes
Write validation results before conditionally calculating the holdout
Do not inspect holdout outcomes for validation failures
Do not change production or the existing forward journal
